title: Animoria configuration
description: Workspace-wide governance policy for Animoria. Every property under "rules" is optional — an absent rule simply does not run. This schema validates only the shapes below; unrecognized rule ids are still accepted (and reported by Animoria itself as unknown, not rejected by the editor), since a rule registered by a future Animoria version should not need this file republished to be usable.

rules.description: Rule configuration, keyed by rule id. Each value is either a bare severity, or a [severity, options] tuple for rules that take options.

no-gif.description: Disallows GIF assets in favor of more efficient animated formats.

no-unreferenced-assets.description: Disallows assets with no detected references in source code.

no-duplicate-content.description: Disallows two assets with byte-identical contents.

no-duplicate-names.description: Disallows two assets sharing the same name (case-insensitive, extension ignored).

max-file-size-kb.description: Disallows assets larger than a configured size threshold, in kibibytes.

oneOf.description: A bare limit in KB. Severity is implied "error".

allowed-formats.description: Restricts which animated asset formats are permitted in the workspace.

oneOf.description: A bare list of permitted formats. Severity is implied "error".

additionalProperties.description: A rule id this schema does not yet know about. Animoria's own config loader — not the editor — is the authority on whether it is valid.

severityOnly.description: This rule takes no options — configure it with a bare severity.
